formula_zh: (min(开盘,收盘) - 最低) / 收盘
intuition_en: Lower wick / close: (min(open,close)-low)/close. Measures the lower shadow as a fraction of price. Longer lower wick = buying pressure.
intuition_zh: 下影线/收盘价：(min(开盘,收盘)-最低)/收盘。衡量下影线占价格的比例。下影线越长=买压越强。
expected_direction_explanation_en: Positive direction: longer lower wick suggests buyers defended lower prices, expecting upward continuation.
expected_direction_explanation_zh: 正向：更长的下影线暗示买方在低价位防守，预期向上延续。
known_limitations_en: Single-candle pattern; low reliability in isolation. Works better as part of multi-factor ensemble.
known_limitations_zh: 单K线形态；单独使用可靠性低。作为多因子集成的一部分效果更好。
horizon_notes_en: Lookback window: 1 bars. Evaluation covers 1h/4h/24h/72h horizons.
